address: 17/62 Mu 6, Paniad Chang Road, Pattaya, Na Kluea, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri, 20150, Thailand
bio: With a limited menu, the kitchen excels in seafood, Thai food and home-made curries with bold, rich flavours. The crab, shrimp, clams and fish are served ultra-fresh at reasonable prices, with rare catches often appearing on the menu. The restaurant doesn't open if the line-catch on that day is not successful. Booking a week in advance is necessary....
